kit.step1: Install LocalGateKeys on the new computer (the same version or a newer one).
kit.step2: Open Backup & restore, choose Restore as a new profile, then pick your backup file (.lgk) from one of the backup folders above or from your copy.
kit.step3: Enter the backup password, then the vault password from when the backup was made. The restore screen tells you which password the file needs.
kit.step4: Check the preview and confirm. A new profile is created; nothing already on that computer is changed.
kit.step5: Unlock the new profile. If you forgot the master password, choose Forgot it? Use recovery phrase, enter the 24 words above and set a new master password.

autoType.disabled: Turn on auto-type in Settings first.
autoType.noWindow: No window to type into. Click the window you want, then try again.
autoType.elevated: That window runs as administrator. LocalGateKeys won't type into it.
autoType.ownWindow: LocalGateKeys won't type into its own windows.
autoType.secureDesktop: Typing isn't possible on this screen.
autoType.changed: Typing stopped because the window changed.
autoType.notAllowed: This login's access rules don't allow typing it.
sync.lanPeersCannotRekeyDevice: Your other paired devices can't receive a new key over Wi-Fi: {shown}. Afterwards pair each of them again (leave sync there, then scan a new QR code), or use Join a folder there with the new sync password. Until then they don't sync with this device.
sync.noSyncGroupPaired: This folder has no sync group. Choose the folder another device in this group already uses. If the group has no cloud folder yet, choose Add a cloud folder to this group.
